name: whom
description: A daily game: one famous face, eight guesses at the first name.

scripts.dev: npm run build && node scripts/seed-local.mjs .wrangler/state && wrangler dev --persist-to .wrangler/state --var SESSION_SECRET:dev --var PUZZLE_SEED:dev
scripts.lint: eslint src worker shared scripts tests vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js prettier.config.js --max-warnings 0
scripts.format: prettier --write src worker shared scripts tests index.html vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js prettier.config.js package.json tsconfig.json wrangler.jsonc release-please-config.json .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src worker shared scripts tests index.html vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js prettier.config.js package.json tsconfig.json wrangler.jsonc release-please-config.json .github
